fields.description: Binghatti Skyflame is a two-tower apartment development in Majan, with stepped terraces and shared recreation spaces. The published drawings separate Tower 1 from Tower 2 and include selected two-bedroom homes with a private pool. A similar type name in another tower should not be treated as an identical apartment.

overview: Tower 1 lists 1,378 homes and 29 shops; Tower 2 lists 782 homes and 19 shops. The developer separates 27 and 22 residential floors respectively from podium, mechanical and roof levels.
The website emphasises studios through two bedrooms; the brochure also records one four-bedroom home in Tower 1. No four-bedroom plan or current availability was established.
research.locationNote: Majan, Dubai, with developer-described connections to E 311 and Sheikh Zayed Road. Verify the selected tower’s access, orientation and outlook independently.
research.priceLabel: Developer published starting guide · reconfirm terms
research.priceNote: The own project page displays AED 585000, without proving a specific unit or payment eligibility. Property Finder’s two separate tower selections currently show AED 1099999. These are different unit/offer references; confirm the price, discount basis and payment option in writing.
research.paymentNote: The developer FAQ states 20%booking,50%during construction and 30%on completion. No exact calendar or selected-unit payment schedule was established from the retrieved primary documents. A discounted cash offer must not be assumed to qualify for this split.
research.handoverNote: The own page estimates 31 December 2027. Treat that as the developer’s forecast, not evidence of completed works or a guaranteed key date. Confirm any tower-specific revision directly.
